title: linked.app.json
description: A linked app's declarative settings, at the app root. Packages never have one.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the file follows. A tool refuses a version it does not know.

prefixes.description: The app's prefix map: prefix → namespace IRI. Its server, its browser bundle and its store queries all use it. Tools only add entries (`linked prefixes`); a rename or removal is the app owner's.
